title: ProtoFlow: Prototype-Guided Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.01320v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative modeling has shown strong promise for multivariate time mseries (MTS) forecasting, especially scale to high-dimensional settings. Diffusion-based methods achieve competitive performance but typically require many sampling steps at inference. VAE-based non-iterative forecasting frameworks have therefore emerged as an efficient alternative. Within this line of work, vector quantization (VQ) enables controllable latent space modeling by mapping multivariate series into compact discrete representations. Existing VQ-based forecasting methods, however, typically rely on autoregressive (AR) token generation, which suffers from exposure bias and training-inference mismatch. Flow matching provides an efficient non-autoregressive alternative for latent forecasting, but existing formulations usually initialize transport from a generic Gaussian prior. translated_title: ProtoFlow：面向多变量时间序列预测的原型引导流匹配
translated_abstract: 生成式建模在多变量时间序列（MTS）预测方面展现出强大潜力，尤其能够较好地扩展到高维场景。基于扩散的方法取得了有竞争力的性能，但通常需要在推理时进行多步采样。因此，基于VAE的非迭代预测框架成为一种高效的替代方案。在这一研究路线中，向量量化（VQ）通过将多变量序列映射为紧凑的离散表示，实现了可控的潜在空间建模。然而，现有的基于VQ的预测方法通常依赖自回归（AR）的token生成方式，存在曝光偏差和训练-推理不一致的问题。流匹配为潜在预测提供了一种高效的非自回归替代方案，但现有方法通常从通用的高斯先验出发进行传输。我们则观察到，训练得到的VQ码本本身已经捕获了代表性的潜在模式……
tldr: 提出ProtoFlow，利用训练好的VQ码本中具有代表性的潜在模式（原型）来引导流匹配的初始传输，从而替代通用高斯先验，实现高效的非自回归多变量时间序列预测。
